help.title: Help & Documentation
help.errorLoading: Error loading help content. Please try again.

createRoadbook.title: Create Roadbook
createRoadbook.description: Create a new roadbook by planning your route. Use the Route Planning mode to add waypoints, customize your path, and generate a detailed roadbook for your journey.

changeLanguage.title: Change Language
changeLanguage.description: Switch between available languages in the Settings menu. The app supports multiple languages to help you navigate comfortably.

exportRoadbook.title: Export Roadbook
exportRoadbook.description: Export your roadbook in various formats. You can download and print your roadbook or share it with fellow travelers.

deleteRoadbook.title: Delete Roadbook
deleteRoadbook.description: Remove a roadbook you no longer need. Navigate to your Routes List, select the route you want to delete, and confirm the deletion.
